# NITEP - Nonprofit IT Empowerment Program

> NITEP is a pooled-volume purchasing program that gives 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations an automatic 20% discount on Boom 365: MSSP Pro managed security services. It is operated by Boom Logic (The Boom Company), a Los Angeles-based MSP/MSSP serving nonprofits and SMBs since 2008 on infrastructure it owns and operates.

## How the program works

- Participating nonprofits' device counts are combined into a single purchasing pool, so every member receives enterprise volume pricing regardless of individual size.
- The 20% discount is automatic for every verified 501(c)(3) - no negotiation, no annual re-qualification.
- Minimum to join: 20 endpoints (workstations, laptops, servers).
- The discount applies to Boom 365: MSSP Pro, Boom Logic's managed security plan with 24/7 monitoring, endpoint protection, and security operations.

## Who it serves

- Community health clinics and Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs)
- Human services, housing, education, arts, culture, and faith-based nonprofits
- Any active 501(c)(3) organization with 20 or more devices

## Compliance and funding support

- Boom Logic provides Compliance as a Service covering HIPAA, CMMC, and NIST frameworks.
- Boom Logic is a SAM.gov-registered vendor and supports grant-funded technology projects, including the Nonprofit Security Grant Program (FEMA/Cal OES) and FCC programs.

## Key pages

- [NITEP overview](https://nitep.org/): Program summary, qualification criteria, and FAQ
- [Application and pricing calculator](https://boomlogic.com/nonprofit-it-empowerment-program/): Apply to join the pool and see exact NITEP rates by endpoint count
- [Boom Logic](https://boomlogic.com/): Program operator - Los Angeles MSP/MSSP, UCaaS, and cloud hosting provider
